data.forwardModel: Ricker-like wavelet responses at wavy reflectors with a two-block time displacement, independent noise and missing observations.
data.reference: Fault band within 1.5 traces of generated fault; one centerline point for each of 56 evaluation rows.

sources.supports: Local trace waveform discontinuity attributes highlight faults and stratigraphic differences; similarity alone does not identify cause.
Faults break seismic horizon continuity; coherence and original amplitude should be interpreted together.

method: 9-feature regularized logistic regression, genuinely optimized for 240 iterations; not a pretrained deep model.
artwork: Original SVG and generated amplitude arrays; no copied reference screenshots.
